blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — Members of the Kalesa Association of Laoag City in nearby Ilocos Norte are undergoing skills training and upgrading of their traditional horse-drawn carriages or “kalesa” as part of an initiative to revive a cultural icon and mode of transportation in the city, the Laoag City Tourism Office said Monday, Nov. 23. The program is spearheaded and funded by the Office of Ilocos Norte’s First District Rep. and House Majority Leader Ferdinand Alexander “Sandro” Marcos III, in partnership with the Department of Social Welfare and Development’s Sustainable Livelihood Program (DSWD-SLP), the Technical Education and Skills Development […]...
